item.title: Public foot path from Bellegrove Road into Ruskin Drive, 6th August
item.description:
The foot path needs regular sweeping from the street cleaners, which appears to be not done, despite the street cleaners been asked to keep clean the pathway, the response is it’s not there patch. The other problem is we seem to have regular fly tipping of black bags and large boxes which are not from the shops as they placed there rubbish in their allocated bins along the pathway. The problem appears to be from home near by. As there are at times house hold items such as furniture, etc. At present there is several black bags of rubbish, lose rubbish and several large boxes which are on the floor on top of the BT phone cupboard . Please can these items be be removed ASAP and fly tipping notices put up from the council in the area. Thank you for your help and consideration in this matter. The rubbish has been there for approx 3/4 weeks and increased over this time.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 68, Bellegrove Road, Welling, Greater London

item.title: Subject: Report of Illegal Parking Blocking the Electric Entrance Gate, 6th August
item.description:
Subject: Report of Illegal Parking Blocking the Electric Entrance Gate Dear Southwark Housing Management, I would like to report an ongoing problem with illegal parking outside our building. Woodsford Portland Street London Vehicles are parked in front of the electric entrance gate almost every day, blocking access and causing inconvenience to residents. This also creates a potential safety risk in case emergency access is needed. Could you please send a housing officer or parking enforcement officer to investigate this issue and take appropriate action? Thanks

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Portland Street, Walworth, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
